name: Whole Raw or Roasted Almonds & Walnuts (Stricture Hazard Warning)
whyItWorks: Whole nuts are hard, dense, and shatter during chewing into jagged angular shards. For individuals with Crohn's strictures or bowel narrowing, unchewed nut fragments act like gravel, accumulating into high-risk mechanical obstructions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture Warning: Avoid whole almonds, walnuts, cashews, pecans, and trail mix. If wanting the nutritional benefits of nuts, use completely smooth almond or cashew butter instead.
watchOuts: A leading clinical trigger for acute small bowel obstruction requiring emergency hospitalization.
